name: Daily ZCTA-Level Stratified Counts of Infectious Disease Admissions
description: Daily counts of infectious disease outcomes stratified by ZCTA, age group, sex, and race.This dataset contains sparse counts, i.e. only combinations of ZCTA, date, and demographic strata with at least one recorded admission are included. Rows with zero counts are omitted.
